// Setter is an interface for a custom value setter.
//
// To implement a custom value setter you need to add a SetValue function to your type that will receive a string raw value:
//
//	type MyField string
//
//	func (f *MyField) SetValue(s string) error {
//		if s == "" {
//			return fmt.Errorf("field value can't be empty")

//		*f = MyField("my field is: " + s)
//		return nil
//	}

	SetValue(string) error
}

// Updater gives an ability to implement custom update function for a field or a whole structure

}

// parseFile parses configuration file according to it's extension
//
// Currently following file extensions are supported:
//
// - yaml
//
// - json
//
// - toml
//
// - env
//
// - edn
func ( string,  interface{}) error {
	// open the configuration file
	,  := os.OpenFile(, os.O_RDONLY|os.O_SYNC, 0)
	if  != nil {
		return 
	}
	defer .Close()

	// parse the file depending on the file type
	switch  := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext());  {
	case ".yaml", ".yml":
		 = ParseYAML(, )
	case ".json":
		 = ParseJSON(, )
	case ".toml":
		 = ParseTOML(, )
	case ".edn":
		 = parseEDN(, )
	case ".env":
		 = parseENV(, )
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("file format '%s' doesn't supported by the parser", )
	}
	if  != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("config file parsing error: %s", .Error())
	}
	return nil
}

// parseValue parses value into the corresponding field.
// In case of maps and slices it uses provided separator to split raw value string

			return .UnmarshalText([]byte())
		} else if ,  := .Addr().Interface().(encoding.TextUnmarshaler);  {
			return .UnmarshalText([]byte())
		}

		if ,  := .Interface().(Setter);  {
			return .SetValue()
		} else if ,  := .Addr().Interface().(Setter);  {
			return .SetValue()
		}
	}

	switch .Kind() {

	// parse string value
	case reflect.String:
		.SetString()

	// parse boolean value
	case reflect.Bool:
		,  := strconv.ParseBool()
		if  != nil {
			return 
		}
		.SetBool()

	// parse integer
	case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32:
		,  := strconv.ParseInt(, 0, .Bits())
		if  != nil {
			return 
		}
		.SetInt()

	case reflect.Int64:

			if  != nil {

			.SetInt(int64())

			// parse regular integer

			if  != nil {
				return 
			}
			.SetInt()

	// parse unsigned integer value
	case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64:
		,  := strconv.ParseUint(, 0, .Bits())
		if  != nil {
			return

		.SetUint()

		,  := strconv.ParseFloat(, .Bits())

// GetDescription returns a description of environment variables.
// You can provide a custom header text.
func ( interface{},  *string) (string, error) {

	if  != nil {

	var  string

	if  != nil {

	} else {
		 = "Environment variables:"
	}

	 := make([]string, 0)

	for ,  := range  {

			continue
		}

		for ,  := range .envList {

			 := fmt.Sprintf("\n  %s %s", , .fieldValue.Kind())
			if  > 0 {
				 += fmt.Sprintf(" (alternative to %s)", .envList[0])
			}
			 += fmt.Sprintf("\n    \t%s", .description)
			if .defValue != nil {
				 += fmt.Sprintf(" (default %q)", *.defValue)
			}
			 = append(, )
		}
	}

	if len() == 0 {
		return "", nil
	}

	sort.Strings()

	return  + strings.Join(, ""), nil
}
